title: High-order harmonic generation in argon driven by short laser pulses: effects of post-pulse propagation and windowing
summary: We present ab initio calculations using the $R$-matrix with time dependence (RMT) method for high-order harmonic generation (HHG) in argon in a short, intense pulse regime. The calculations employ a $6$-cycle $\sin^2$ pulse at $850$ nm with peak intensity $2.3\times 10^{14}$ W/cm$^2$ and, for comparison with the experiment by Guo et al. [J. Phys. B: At. Mol. Opt. Phys. 51, 034006 (2018)], a Gaussian pulse with the same frequency and peak intensity. Both pulse shapes yield the expected harmonic structure in the region above the ionization threshold (approximately $15.82$ eV in $LS$-coupling).…
